title: Skills, extracted (folio-assistant-core)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every skill's front matter: `name` as the label, `description` as the definition. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.definition: Answer a question from a corpus this folio already holds, iteratively, and stop on a stated condition. The four roles, the two stopping conditions and why both are load-bearing, the granularity choice, and the three things this repository must NOT adopt along with the method.
